physicalNotes: Radius 0.82 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Sun et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-411 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...624A..15S/abstract): 570,474 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.87 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Sun et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-411 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...624A..15S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4837 +/- 149.59 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of Kepler-411 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
